Title: Public Preview: Risk and safety evaluations for image and multimodal content in Microsoft Foundry

Body.Content:
Risk and safety evaluations for images and multimodal content are now available in public preview in Microsoft Foundry. These evaluations can help organizations assess the frequency and severity of harmful content in human and AI-generated outputs to prioritize relevant risk mitigations in their generative AI applications. For example, these evaluations can help organizations assess content risks in cases where 1) text inputs yield image outputs, 2) a combination of image and text inputs produce text outputs, and 3) images containing text (like memes) generate text and/or image outputs. 

Learn more.
